description: Establishment of the National Commission for Research and Development
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-06-22 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Research and development activities are considered as an essential factor in accelerating a country's knowledge-based economic growth, promoting innovation, enhancing competitiveness, and achieving sustainable development goals which contribute the production of value-added goods and services, strengthening the human and social development and introducing innovative solutions to national problems, and managing sustainable environment. Due to the centralization of research and development activities in this country in only a few limited areas, weak coordination between entities, and insufficient policy and financial support, it has not been possible to achieve the anticipated outcomes from the resources deployed for the same. Therefore, the need to establish a National Commission, similar to those established in developed countries, and an office equipped with capability and competency to execute its relevant functions has been identified, so as to establish an efficient and integrated mechanism that can link the entire process of research and development. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to establish the National Commission for Research and Development in order to empower the research and development process that is carried out separately in various Ministries and Institutions, within a single framework and to effectively use the research outcomes, and to appoint a Committee to prepare a Preliminary Draft/Concept Paper to introduce legal provisions for the same, was approved by the Cabinet.
